units.previous_finding: F02 (stable index 108; evidence data/quality-check-review-evidence/fi-FI/qc-001-example-104-122.md): English Fetch returns the body of URL and a slice of URLs found on that page; Finnish Fetch palauttaa sivun URL sisällön sekä viipaleen sivulta löytyvistä URL-osoitteista. The noun relationship sivun URL sisällön is awkward and ambiguous rather than clearly denoting the retrieved web page body. English Crawl uses fetcher to recursively crawl pages starting with url, to a maximum of depth; Finnish alkaen url-osoitteesta enintään depth-syvyyteen asti is also cumbersome. The original fi-FI Generation session must revise these two comment expressions in natural Finnish, preserving URL, Fetch, Crawl, url, depth and all Go code/structure.
